subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: What shared inbound attachment metadata shape should agents receive for Slack, Discord, Telegram, and future channel plugins?
rationale: The remaining gap changes the channel-to-agent context contract, and adding Slack-only fields would likely create a competing source of truth for attachment data.

options.title: Design shared attachment metadata
options.body: Add a cross-channel metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

options.title: Accept a Slack-only stopgap
options.body: Expose only Slack file metadata now while accepting later migration risk if other channel plugins need a different shape.

options.title: Keep the placeholder workflow
options.body: Keep current fileId placeholders plus download-file access and close this direction as not planned after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Design shared attachment metadata
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

likelyOwner.reason: They are already in the issue discussion and have recent Slack media-path ownership, making them the best available owner for the contract choice.
